Provides a resource to create a SSM secret version using the terraform-plugin-framework implementation.

This is the framework-based counterpart of `tencentcloud.Ssm.SecretVersion`. It additionally supports a write-only attribute `secretStringWo` whose value is never persisted in pulumi preview or state.

> **Note:** Exactly one of `secretBinary`, `secretString` or `secretStringWo` must be set. A maximum of 10 versions can exist under one credential. Only credentials in the enabled or disabled state can have new versions added.

## Import



SSM secret version (v2) can be imported using `secretName#versionId`, e.g.
```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Ssm/secretVersionV2:SecretVersionV2 v1 test#v1
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
